description: Circle of Wildfire Druids summon wildfire spirits to aid them in battle and traverse dangerous terrain.

features.name: Wildfire Spirit
features.description: You can summon a wildfire spirit that appears in a space within 30 feet. The spirit can move and take actions on your turn.

features.name: Spirit Teleportation
features.description: You can use the wildfire spirit to teleport yourself or swap positions with it.

features.name: Enhanced Bonfire
features.description: The wildfire spirit's damage increases, and it grants you damage resistance to fire.

features.name: Blazing Endurance
features.description: When the wildfire spirit is destroyed, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Druid level.
